UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Public profile information for an authenticated user.

photoURL.description: Avatar photo URL from Google Auth.

SavedTrack.title: SavedTrack
SavedTrack.description: AI-generated retro music clip or full-length track created via Lyria.

id.description: Unique identifier for the generated track.

userId.description: UID of the user who generated this track.

title.description: Name or title for the track.

prompt.description: Prompt used to synthesize the audio.

model.description: Model used, e.g. lyria-3-clip-preview or lyria-3-pro-preview.

audioData.description: Base64 data URI of the generated WAV audio.

SavedResearch.title: SavedResearch
SavedResearch.description: Archival research notes grounded with Google Search data on 1980s Indian transit & cassette culture.

id.description: Unique identifier for the research note.

userId.description: UID of the user who saved the research.

topic.description: Short topic label (e.g. Vintage Bus Lines, Cassette Boomboxes, Auto-Rickshaw Design).

summary.description: Detailed verified historical facts grounded via Google Search.

UserPreferences.title: UserPreferences
UserPreferences.description: Persisted paper grain texture and canvas viewing preferences.

blendMode.description: Blend mode used for canvas overlay.

/users/{userId}.description: Public profile documents for authenticated users.

/saved_tracks/{trackId}.description: User generated music tracks and clips from Lyria.

/saved_research/{researchId}.description: Grounded historical search queries and research summaries.

/user_preferences/{userId}.description: User customized canvas paper grain and visual settings.
